parts.question: renal dosing guidance for moderate impairment and hepatic monitoring; hepatic monitoring and its escalation thresholds for hepatic; renal dosing by eGFR category for egfr, renal

result.answer: For moderate renal impairment (eGFR 30-59), the starting dose is 25 mg once daily, the maximum is 50 mg/day, and monitoring requires a recheck in 2-4 weeks [E1, E2, E3]. Renal dosing by eGFR category is: Normal (>=90) starting dose 50 mg OD, maximum 100 mg/day, routine monitoring [E2]; Mild (60-89) starting dose 50 mg OD, maximum 100 mg/day, routine monitoring [E2]; Moderate (30-59) starting dose 25 mg once daily, maximum 50 mg/day, recheck 2-4 weeks monitoring [E1, E2, E3]; Severe (15-29) specialist review, maximum 25 mg/day, enhanced monitoring [E2]. Baseline hepatic laboratory values are required with repeat testing between Day 14 and Day 21 [E1].
